# econ-skills (zbsaygin)

license: `MIT` · 7 skills · last update: 2026-09

**Source:** <https://github.com/zbsaygin/econ-skills>

**Maintainers:** zbsaygin

**Related project entry:** [`econ-skills`](../projects/econ-skills.md)

**Compatibility:** `claude-code`

> Seven Claude Code skills for academic economics research, assuming a Zotero + Better BibTeX bibliography workflow with citekeys in authorShorttitleYear form. Requires replacing ~10 user-specific placeholders (project directories, bibliography path, author identity for LaTeX templates) after cloning. Distinct from the separately-maintained, differently-scoped `econ-research-skills` (hanlulong/econ-paper-review-skill) already in this catalog.
